calls.statement:
SELECT 
  SUM(fsl.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dp.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products'
  AND ds.store_id = 107
  AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 5

SELECT 
  fsl.channel_code,
  SUM(fsl.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dp.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products'
  AND ds.store_id = 107
  AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY fsl.channel_code

SELECT 
  fsl.channel_code,
  fsl.channel_id,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  SUM(fsl.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dp.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products'
  AND ds.store_id = 107
  AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY fsl.channel_code, fsl.channel_id
